title: CLI resolves ports, paths, proxies and native-binding overrides from the environment
intent: Observed across @tailwindcss/oxide, rolldown, parcel, testcontainers, typescript and astro patch releases: named reads of configuration variables (PORT, HOME, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, DOCKER_CONFIG, NAPI_RS_NATIVE_LIBRARY_PATH, npm_config_https_proxy), writing PATH, destructuring non-secret names, handing the whole environment to a child or a loader, and process.env in comments. None of it reads a secret, so code.credential-access must stay quiet and the modified file must roll up low.
